metadata.title: Sharp Partial Regularity of Weakly Pseudoholomorphic Maps Into Projective Algebraic Varieties
metadata.abstract: For every $m\geq2$, we prove that a weakly pseudoholomorphic $W^{1,2}_{\mathrm{loc}}$ map from a real-analytic almost complex $2m$-manifold into a projective algebraic variety has a countably $(2m-4)$-rectifiable singular set. When $m=2$, the singular set is shown to be locally finite. We first establish both conclusions on smooth almost complex domains under the additional assumption that the pullback of the Fubini--Study form is distributionally closed. We then show that this conservation law follows from the Cauchy--Riemann equation alone on real-analytic domains.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 弱拟全纯映射的尖锐部分正则性
analysis.workSummary: 实解析殆复 2m 维流形（m≥2）到射影代数簇的弱拟全纯 W¹,²_loc 映射，其奇点集可数 (2m−4) 可求长。m=2 时奇点局部有限。作者先在光滑殆复定义域上额外假设拉回 Fubini–Study 形式分布闭时证明结论，再证明实解析情形中 Cauchy–Riemann 方程蕴含该守恒律。
techniques: 分布闭的 Fubini–Study 拉回
analysis.breakthrough: 把光滑定义域下的条件部分正则性推进到实解析定义域中的方程内蕴结论，并在实四维得到离散程度的尖锐强化。
analysis.limitations: 无额外守恒律的结论要求实解析定义域。m=2 的局部有限强于一般可数零维可求长。目标限定射影代数簇。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。 本轮未取得PDF全文，AI披露尚待核查。
analysis.priorityReason: 弱几何 PDE 的奇点结构与临界能量守恒。
